name: Nishino Kasumi
source:
The only member of the boxing club, she spends her whole day training on the university grounds.
For certain reasons she's canvassed into the Scientific Investigation Club.
She's a lively and sociable girl-- the polar opposite of Shuuta.
She initially doesn't take too kindly to Shuuta, who's fixated on theory.
She's not fond or good at studying. She loves eating. Her favourite food is gyuudon.

[Translated from the [url=https://glovety.product.co.jp/]official site[/url]]
